issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without explanation in a CI-fix PR
issues.detail: The PR description only mentions fixing mmengine/mmcv. Silently bumping mmdet a minor version expands the change surface and may introduce behavioral or compatibility differences beyond the stated scope. Either revert to 3.2.0 or document why 3.3.0 is required (e.g., compatibility with mmengine 0.10.7).

issues.description: setuptools<82 cap leaked into a published package's install_requires
issues.detail: Adding `setuptools<82` to core/setup.py install_requires forces this constraint on every end user of autogluon.core, not just CI. Setuptools is a build-time dep; pinning it at install time can cause solver conflicts in user environments unrelated to the mmcv/mmengine CI bug. This belongs in CI scripts, not the package extras_require.

issues.description: mmcv installed with --no-build-isolation may pick up unintended host packages
issues.detail: Switching from mim to pip with `--no-build-isolation` means mmcv's build uses whatever torch/numpy/setuptools is in the active env. If the CI image's versions drift, builds can silently fail or compile against the wrong torch ABI. Worth pinning the build env (torch, numpy) explicitly or documenting the required pre-installed state.

issues.description: Install order risks mmcv resolving against a different mmengine than installed after
issues.detail: mmcv 2.1.0 is installed before mmengine 0.10.7. mmcv's runtime requires mmengine; if pip auto-pulls a different mmengine as a transitive dep during the mmcv install, the explicit `mmengine==0.10.7` install after may either be a no-op or downgrade. Installing mmengine first is safer.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack owner/tracking beyond the upstream issue
issues.detail: Both FIXMEs reference open-mmlab/mmcv#3325 but there's no internal tracking issue or owner. When upstream eventually fixes it, this cap may persist for months. Consider adding an internal TODO with an assignee or a date-based review reminder.

issues.description: extras_require key context for setuptools<82 not clear from diff
issues.detail: The cap is added to one extras key without commentary. Future maintainers won't know it's tied to the mmcv/mmengine CI workaround. Add a brief comment matching the FIXME style in the shell scripts referencing the upstream issue, so the cap can be removed in sync.

review.summary: The PR works around a setuptools>=82 incompatibility in mmcv/mmengine by capping setuptools and switching from git/mim installs to pinned PyPI wheels. Main concerns: the setuptools<82 cap leaks into the published autogluon.core install_requires (affecting end users, not just CI), mmdet is silently bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without explanation, and the new mmcv install uses --no-build-isolation which depends on ambient env state. Install order of mmcv before mmengine and missing internal tracking for the FIXMEs are smaller concerns.
